topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: I carefully brushed the dirt off the aged metal, my hands trembling as the markings on the lid came into view. It was unmistakably a time capsule, but I had no recollection of ever burying it here, in this little corner of my garden. The box was modest, not more than a foot long, but the weight of it seemed to carry the stories of another time. With a mix of curiosity and a sudden caution, I hesitated before opening it. What treasures or secrets could it possibly hold? What would it reveal about a past version of me, or perhaps someone else entirely? The possibilities swirled as I gently lifted the lid.
